tool.name: ml-inference
tool.description: predict cell types with an uploaded CellTypist model
tool.command: mkdir -p output && python3 '$__tool_directory__/predict_celltypist.py' --input '$input_file' --model '$model_file' --predicted-labels 'output/predicted_labels.csv' --decision-matrix 'output/decision_matrix.csv' --probability-matrix 'output/probability_matrix.csv' --mode '$prediction.mode' #if $prediction.mode == 'prob_match' --probability-threshold '$prediction.probability_threshold' #end if #if str($transpose_input) == 'true' --transpose-input #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Single-cell raw-count matrix
param.help: Cells by genes, with cell identifiers in the first column and gene symbols in the header.

param.name: model_file
param.label: CellTypist model (.pkl)
param.help: A trusted CellTypist model pickle, such as Immune_All_Low.pkl. Pickle files can execute code while loading; only upload models from trusted sources.

param.name: transpose_input
param.label: Genes are rows and cells are columns

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool applies an uploaded CellTypist logistic-regression model to a single-cell raw-count matrix inside the local ``inference-container:0.1`` image. It performs CellTypist-compatible count normalization, gene matching, scaling, and prediction.
Supply CSV or tabular data with cells in rows and gene symbols in columns. The first column contains cell identifiers. Enable **Genes are rows and cells are columns** for a transposed matrix. Upload a trusted CellTypist ``.pkl`` model such as ``Immune_All_Low.pkl``.
The output collection contains ``predicted_labels.csv``, ``decision_matrix.csv``, and ``probability_matrix.csv``.
